vi.R: Đây là thư của vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa gửi cho mọi người thuộc mọi dân tộc và ngôn ngữ trên khắp thế giới. Chúc các ngươi được bình an và thịnh vượng!

sw.L: Nebukadneza mfalme, kwa watu wote, mataifa na lugha wakaao katika dunia yote: Amani yenu na iongezeke!
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Mfalme Nebukadneza, kwa watu wote, mataifa na watu wa kila lugha wanaoishi duniani kote: Amani iwe kwenu tele!
sw.R: Barua hii inatoka kwa Mfalme Nebukadneza kwenda kwa watu wa kila taifa na kila lugha duniani kote. Nawatakia amani na mafanikio!

am.L: ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ለሚኖሩ ወገኖች፣ ሕዝቦችና ቋንቋዎች ሁሉ፦ ሰላማችሁ ይብዛ!
am.B: ከንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር፣ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ለሚኖሩ ወገኖች፣ ሕዝቦችና የየቋንቋው ሰዎች ሁሉ፦ ሰላም በብዛት ይሁንላችሁ!
am.R: ይህ ደብዳቤ ከንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በዓለም ሁሉ ላሉ የየሕዝቡና የየቋንቋው ሰዎች ሁሉ የተላከ ነው። ሰላምና ስኬት ይሁንላችሁ!

hi.L: राजा नबूकदनेस्सर की ओर से सारी पृथ्वी पर रहनेवाले सब लोगों, जातियों और भाषाओं को: तुम्हारी शान्ति बढ़ती जाए!
hi.B: राजा नबूकदनेस्सर की ओर से, सारी पृथ्वी पर रहनेवाले सब लोगों, देशों और भिन्न-भिन्न भाषा बोलनेवालों को: तुम्हें भरपूर शान्ति मिले!
hi.R: यह पत्र राजा नबूकदनेस्सर की ओर से सारी दुनिया के हर देश और हर भाषा के लोगों के नाम है। मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम्हें शान्ति और सफलता मिले!

ru.L: Навуходоносор царь — всем племенам, народам и языкам, живущим по всей земле: мир ваш да умножится!
ru.B: От царя Навуходоносора — всем племенам, народам и людям всех языков, живущим по всей земле: да будет у вас мир в изобилии!
ru.R: Это письмо от царя Навуходоносора людям всех народов и языков по всему миру. Желаю вам мира и благополучия!

ja.L: ネブカドネツァル王から、全地に住むすべての諸民族、諸国民、諸言語の者たちへ。あなたがたの平安が増し加わるように。
ja.B: ネブカドネツァル王から、全地に住む諸民族、諸国民、さまざまな言葉のすべての人々へ。あなたがたに平安が豊かにあるように。
ja.R: これは、ネブカドネツァル王から、世界中のあらゆる国の人々、あらゆる言葉を話す人々への手紙である。あなたがたに平安と繁栄があるように。

uk.L: Навуходоносор цар — усім народам, племенам і мовам, які живуть на всій землі: Нехай ваш мир помножиться!
uk.B: Від царя Навуходоносора — усім народам, племенам і людям усіх мов, що живуть на всій землі: Нехай мир ваш буде рясний!
uk.R: Цей лист — від царя Навуходоносора до людей усіх народів і мов по всьому світу. Бажаю вам миру й добробуту!

decisions.choice: This verse is 3:31 in the Aramaic text, 4:1 in Bibles that follow the Latin and later numbering
decisions.reason: The Aramaic text ends chapter 3 with the opening of Nebuchadnezzar's letter (3:31-33) and begins chapter 4 with "I, Nebuchadnezzar". Many Bibles number these three verses 4:1-3, so their 4:1-3 is 3:31-33 here, and their 4:4-37 is 4:1-34 here. Open Word Bible follows the numbering of the text it translates. The three verses open the letter that runs through chapter 4.

decisions.choice: a royal letter: the king's greeting to his empire
decisions.reason: The verse is the opening of a letter in the form kings used: the sender, the receivers, then a greeting. The greeting "may your peace increase" is the one Darius uses in 6:26. Chapter 4 is the body of the letter, told by the king himself.

decisions.choice: the start of a hymn: verses 32-33 are a song of praise
decisions.reason: Nebuchadnezzar's greeting leads into a short song of praise (verses 32-33), like Daniel's in 2:20-23. Its last lines return at the end of the letter (4:31).

decisions.choice: the greeting as prose, the hymn in lines; peace and success (R)
decisions.reason: The terms for Daniel set 3:31-33 in lines. This verse, the letter's greeting, is a single unit in the Aramaic accents, so like a psalm title it stays on one line; the hymn of verses 32-33 is set in lines. Peace here is the full well-being of a people; Readable adds "success" to show its range. The letter is not given quotation marks, since the king himself speaks it as narrator.

decisions.choice: vocês
decisions.reason: The king's letter speaks to all his peoples with "vocês", as he speaks to his subjects throughout (2:5).

decisions.choice: "Que votre paix soit multipliée !" (L), "Que la paix vous soit donnée en abondance !" (B), "Je vous souhaite paix et prospérité !" (R), here and at 6:26
decisions.reason: The royal greeting, as the term sheet sets it; Readable uses the wish of the Aramaic letters in published Ezra.

decisions.choice: "¡Que la paz les sea multiplicada!" (L, B); "¡Les deseo paz y prosperidad!" / "¡Os deseo paz y prosperidad!" (R)
decisions.reason: The royal greeting to all the peoples takes plural_you; R gives the sense in plain words, as the English R does

decisions.choice: the royal letter: "ta" for the king, "các ngươi" for his peoples
decisions.reason: Chapter 4 is the king's own letter. He writes of himself as "ta" and to his peoples as "các ngươi", as kings speak throughout the book; the greeting "peace" is "bình an", as in the Ezra letters.

decisions.choice: The king's letter (3:31-4:34) is in the plain style: 해라체 to the readers and "나" for himself, with the greeting "평안이 넘치기를 빈다"
decisions.reason: The term sheet sets decrees and letters in 해라체, as the Persian kings' letters in Ezra; the account Nebuchadnezzar gives in chapter 4 stays in the same voice.

decisions.choice: "Amani yenu na iongezeke!" (L); "Amani iwe kwenu tele!" (B); "Nawatakia amani na mafanikio!" (R)
decisions.reason: The greeting of a royal letter; the same wording opens the letter of Darius (6:26).

decisions.choice: "ሰላማችሁ ይብዛ!" (L)
decisions.reason: The letter greeting "may your peace increase", close to the "ይብዛላችሁ" of 1 Peter 1:2 on main, which uses the same greeting. 3:31-33 are 4:1-3 in Bibles that follow the later numbering (m1).

decisions.choice: "мир ваш да умножится" (L); "да будет у вас мир в изобилии" (B); "Желаю вам мира и благополучия" (R); one line
decisions.reason: The royal greeting (m2) keeps the form of a letter's opening at each level and, like a psalm title, stands on one line before the hymn, as the English has it.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadnezzar's letter (3:31-4:34) in the plain style at every level, the Readable too, with the king as "わたし"; speeches inside it keep their own registers (Daniel to the king polite)
decisions.reason: A royal proclamation, like the Persian decrees of Ezra, which are plain at every level; the Readable's です・ます is for the narrator's voice, and here the king himself speaks.

decisions.choice: shelamkhon "平安" (greeting) at every level; R "平安と繁栄" as the English Readable
decisions.reason: Style guide table: 平安 for a greeting.

source.text: אָֽתַיָּא֙ וְתִמְהַיָּ֔א דִּ֚י עֲבַ֣ד עִמִּ֔י אֱלָהָ֖א עִלָּאָ֑ה שְׁפַ֥ר קָֽדָמַ֖י לְהַחֲוָיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The signs and the wonders which has done with me God Most High, it seemed good before me to declare.

en.L: The signs and the wonders that the Most High God has done for me \q it has seemed good to me to declare.
en.B: I am pleased to make known to you \q the signs and wonders that the Most High God has done for me.
en.R: I want to tell you \q about the amazing things the Most High God has done for me.

pt.L: Os sinais e as maravilhas que o Deus Altíssimo fez comigo \q pareceu-me bem anunciá-los.
pt.B: Tenho prazer em dar a conhecer a vocês \q os sinais e as maravilhas que o Deus Altíssimo fez por mim.
pt.R: Quero contar a vocês \q as coisas maravilhosas que o Deus Altíssimo fez por mim.

fr.L: Les signes et les prodiges que le Dieu Très-Haut a faits pour moi, \q il m’a paru bon de les faire connaître.
fr.B: Il me plaît de vous faire connaître \q les signes et les prodiges que le Dieu Très-Haut a accomplis pour moi.
fr.R: Je veux vous raconter \q les choses extraordinaires que le Dieu Très-Haut a faites pour moi.

es.L: Las señales y los prodigios que el Dios Altísimo ha hecho conmigo \q me ha parecido bien declararlos.
es.B: Me complace dar a conocer \q las señales y los prodigios que el Dios Altísimo ha hecho conmigo.
es.R: Quiero {{plural_you:contarles|contaros}} \q las cosas maravillosas que el Dios Altísimo ha hecho por mí.

ko.L: 지극히 높으신 하나님께서 나에게 행하신 표적들과 기사들을 \q 알리는 것이 내게 좋아 보였다.
ko.B: 지극히 높으신 하나님께서 나에게 행하신 표적과 기사를 \q 너희에게 알리게 되어 기쁘다.
ko.R: 가장 높으신 하나님께서 나에게 하신 놀라운 일들을 \q 너희에게 이야기해 주고 싶다.

vi.L: Những dấu lạ và những phép lạ mà Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao đã làm cho ta, \q ta thấy tốt để công bố.
vi.B: Ta vui lòng cho các ngươi biết \q những dấu lạ và phép lạ mà Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao đã làm cho ta.
vi.R: Ta muốn kể cho các ngươi nghe \q về những việc kỳ diệu Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao đã làm cho ta.

sw.L: Ishara na maajabu ambayo Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa amenitendea \q nimeona vema kuyatangaza.
sw.B: Nimefurahi kuwajulisha \q ishara na maajabu ambayo Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa amenitendea.
sw.R: Nataka kuwaeleza \q mambo ya ajabu ambayo Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa amenitendea.

am.L: ልዑል እግዚአብሔር ለእኔ ያደረጋቸውን ምልክቶችና ድንቆች \q መግለጥ በፊቴ መልካም ሆኖ ታየኝ።
am.B: ልዑል እግዚአብሔር ለእኔ ያደረገልኝን \q ምልክቶችና ድንቆች ልገልጥላችሁ ደስ ይለኛል።
am.R: ልዑል እግዚአብሔር ያደረገልኝን \q አስደናቂ ነገሮች ልነግራችሁ እወዳለሁ።

hi.L: जो चिह्न और चमत्कार परमप्रधान परमेश्वर ने मेरे लिए किए हैं, \q उन्हें बताना मुझे अच्छा लगा है।
hi.B: मुझे यह अच्छा लगा कि तुम्हें बताऊँ \q कि परमप्रधान परमेश्वर ने मेरे लिए कौन-कौन से चिह्न और चमत्कार किए हैं।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें बताना चाहता हूँ \q कि परमप्रधान परमेश्वर ने मेरे लिए कैसे अद्भुत काम किए हैं।

ru.L: Знамения и чудеса, которые сотворил со мной Бог Всевышний, \q мне угодно возвестить.
ru.B: Мне угодно возвестить вам \q о знамениях и чудесах, которые сотворил для меня Всевышний Бог.
ru.R: Я хочу рассказать вам \q об удивительных делах, которые сделал для меня Всевышний Бог.

ja.L: いと高き神がわたしに行われたしるしと不思議を、 \q わたしは告げ知らせることを良しとした。
ja.B: わたしは喜んで知らせよう。 \q いと高き神がわたしのために行われた、しるしと不思議を。
ja.R: あなたがたに話したい。 \q いと高き神が、わたしにしてくださった驚くべきことを。

uk.L: Знаки і чуда, які вчинив для мене Бог Всевишній, \q мені вподобалося обʼявити.
uk.B: Мені приємно розповісти вам \q про знаки й чуда, які вчинив для мене Бог Всевишній.
uk.R: Я хочу розповісти вам \q про дивовижні речі, які зробив для мене Бог Всевишній.

decisions.choice: signs and wonders: acts of God that show his power
decisions.reason: The pair is used of God's acts in Egypt at the exodus (Deuteronomy 4:34; 6:22). Here they are what God did to Nebuchadnezzar in chapter 4: his humbling and his restoring.

decisions.choice: the Most High God: the title of 3:26
decisions.reason: The king calls Israel's God by the title he used in 3:26. In chapter 4 it becomes his main name for God (4:14, 21-22, 29, 31).

decisions.choice: I am pleased to make known (B); I want to tell you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the main verb first, as English poetry needs, keeping two lines.

decisions.choice: dấu lạ, phép lạ (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Signs and wonders" are "dấu lạ và phép lạ", the pair the published Deuteronomy (26:8) and Acts use; Readable says "việc kỳ diệu".

decisions.choice: The two lines keep Korean order (object first, verb last) at every level
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb at the end, so the line about the signs comes first and "I am pleased to make known" closes the verse; the division of the verse into its two parts is kept.

decisions.choice: "चिह्न और चमत्कार" for "signs and wonders"
decisions.reason: The pair as the Hindi Pentateuch and Acts have it; Readable says अद्भुत काम, as the English Readable says "amazing things".

decisions.choice: 'atayya vetimhayya "しるしと不思議" (L, B), "驚くべきこと" / "奇跡" and "不思議なわざ" (R)
decisions.reason: As the NT pair signs and wonders; the hymn lines (3:32-33) are plain, as the poetry rule.

source.text: אָת֨וֹהִי֙ כְּמָ֣ה רַבְרְבִ֔ין וְתִמְה֖וֹהִי כְּמָ֣ה תַקִּיפִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְשָׁלְטָנֵ֖הּ עִם־דָּ֥ר וְדָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: His signs, how great! And his wonders, how mighty! His kingdom [is] a kingdom everlasting, and his dominion [is] with generation and generation.

en.L: His signs, how great [they are]! \q And {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders, how mighty! \q His kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dominion [is] with generation and generation.
en.B: How great are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} signs! \q How powerful are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders! \q His kingdom is a kingdom for all ages; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rule lasts through every generation.
en.R: His miracles are great! \q His wonders are mighty! \q His kingdom will never end. \q He will rule over people in every age.

pt.L: Os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} sinais, como [são] grandes! \q E as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas, como [são] poderosas! \q O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reino [é] um reino eterno, \q e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} domínio [é] de geração em geração.
pt.B: Como são grandes os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} sinais! \q Como são poderosas as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas! \q O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reino é um reino para todas as eras; \q o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} domínio dura por todas as gerações.
pt.R: Os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} milagres são grandes! \q As {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas são poderosas! \q O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reino nunca vai acabar. \q Ele vai governar sobre as pessoas em todas as épocas.

fr.L: Ses signes, combien [ils sont] grands ! \q Et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prodiges, combien puissants ! \q Son royaume [est] un royaume de tous les âges, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} domination [dure] de génération en génération.
fr.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} signes sont grands ! \q Que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prodiges sont puissants ! \q Son royaume est un royaume éternel ; \q {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} domination dure de génération en génération.
fr.R: Ses miracles sont grands ! \q Ses prodiges sont puissants ! \q Son royaume ne finira jamais. \q Il régnera sur les gens de tous les temps.

es.L: ¡Sus señales, cuán grandes [son]! \q ¡Y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} prodigios, cuán poderosos! \q Su reino [es] reino de todos los siglos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} dominio [es] de generación en generación.
es.B: ¡Qué grandes son {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} señales! \q ¡Qué poderosos son {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} prodigios! \q Su reino es un reino para todos los siglos; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} dominio dura de generación en generación.
es.R: ¡Sus milagros son grandes! \q ¡Sus prodigios son poderosos! \q Su reino nunca se acabará. \q Él reinará sobre la gente de todas las épocas.

ko.L: 그분의 표적들이 얼마나 크며, \q 그분의 기사들이 얼마나 능한가! \q 그분의 나라는 영원한 나라이고, \q 그분의 통치는 대대로 이어진다.
ko.B: 그분의 표적은 얼마나 크며, \q 그분의 기사는 얼마나 놀라운가! \q 그분의 나라는 영원한 나라이고, \q 그분의 다스리심은 대대로 이어진다.
ko.R: 그분의 기적은 크고 \q 그분이 하시는 일은 놀랍다! \q 그분의 나라는 끝이 없을 것이고, \q 그분은 모든 세대의 사람들을 다스리실 것이다.

vi.L: Các dấu lạ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao biết bao! \q Và các phép lạ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mạnh mẽ biết bao! \q Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] vương quốc của mọi thời đại, \q và quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] từ đời nọ sang đời kia.
vi.B: Các dấu lạ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao biết bao! \q Các phép lạ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật mạnh mẽ biết bao! \q Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là vương quốc muôn đời; \q quyền cai trị của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn mãi qua mọi thế hệ.
vi.R: Các việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao! \q Các phép lạ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật mạnh mẽ! \q Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt. \q Ngài sẽ cai trị loài người trong mọi thời đại.

sw.L: Ishara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ni kuu kama nini! \q Na maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yana nguvu kama nini! \q Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [ni] ufalme wa nyakati zote, \q na utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [ni] pamoja na kizazi na kizazi.
sw.B: Ishara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ni kuu mno! \q Maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yana uweza mwingi! \q Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ni ufalme wa nyakati zote; \q utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wadumu katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: Ishara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ni kubwa! \q Maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yana nguvu! \q Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hautakwisha kamwe. \q Atawatawala watu wa kila kizazi.

am.L: ምልክቶቹ እንዴት ታላላቅ [ናቸው]! \q ድንቆቹም እንዴት ብርቱዎች ናቸው! \q መንግሥቱ የዘላለም መንግሥት [ነው]፤ \q ግዛቱም ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ [ነው]።
am.B: ምልክቶቹ እንዴት ታላላቅ ናቸው! \q ድንቆቹም እንዴት ኃያላን ናቸው! \q መንግሥቱ የዘላለም መንግሥት ነው፤ \q ግዛቱም ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ይኖራል።
am.R: ተአምራቱ ታላላቅ ናቸው! \q ድንቆቹም ኃያላን ናቸው! \q መንግሥቱ ከቶ አያልቅም። \q በየዘመኑ ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ ይገዛል።

hi.L: उनके चिह्न कैसे बड़े [हैं]! \q और उनके चमत्कार कैसे सामर्थी! \q उनका राज्य सब युगों का राज्य [है], \q और उनकी प्रभुता पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक [बनी रहती है]।
hi.B: उनके चिह्न कैसे महान हैं! \q उनके चमत्कार कैसे सामर्थी हैं! \q उनका राज्य सब युगों तक रहनेवाला राज्य है; \q उनका शासन हर पीढ़ी में बना रहता है।
hi.R: उनके चिह्न महान हैं! \q उनके चमत्कार सामर्थी हैं! \q उनका राज्य कभी समाप्त नहीं होगा। \q वे हर युग में लोगों पर राज्य करेंगे।

ru.L: Знамения {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} — как велики! \q И чудеса {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} — как могущественны! \q Царство {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} — царство всех веков, \q и власть {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} — во всяком роде и роде.
ru.B: Как велики {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} знамения! \q Как могущественны {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} чудеса! \q Царство {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} — царство на все века, \q и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} власть длится во всех поколениях.
ru.R: Его чудеса велики! \q Его дела полны силы! \q Его царство никогда не кончится. \q Он будет править людьми во все времена.

ja.L: その方のしるしは、なんと偉大なことか！ \q その不思議は、なんと力強いことか！ \q その方の国はとこしえの国、 \q その主権は代々に及ぶ。
ja.B: なんと偉大なことか、その方のしるしは！ \q なんと力強いことか、その不思議は！ \q その方の国は永遠の国、 \q その支配は代々に続く。
ja.R: 神の奇跡は、なんと偉大なことか！ \q 神の不思議なわざは、なんと力強いことか！ \q その国は、決して終わらない。 \q 神は、いつの時代の人々も治められる。

uk.L: Його знаки — які великі! \q І {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} чуда — які могутні! \q Його царство — царство вічне, \q і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} влада — з роду в рід.
uk.B: Які великі {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} знаки! \q Які могутні {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} чуда! \q Його царство — царство на всі віки; \q {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} влада триває з роду в рід.
uk.R: Його чуда великі! \q Його дива могутні! \q Його царство ніколи не скінчиться. \q Він пануватиме над людьми в усі віки.

decisions.choice: his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom: the words of Psalm 145:13
decisions.reason: The lines are close to Psalm 145:13: "Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations." They return at the end of the letter (4:31) and in Darius's decree (6:27), and they answer the dream of chapter 2: only God's kingdom lasts forever (2:44).

decisions.choice: with generation and generation: through all generations
decisions.reason: The Aramaic says that his rule is "with generation and generation", that is, it lasts from one generation to the next, without end.

decisions.choice: the verse set in four lines; miracles (R)
decisions.reason: The four lines follow the Aramaic accents. Inside a sentence, "his" for God takes the divine pronoun setting; at the start of a sentence it is capitalized either way. Readable says "miracles" for "signs". The last two lines reuse the published wording of Psalm 145:13 at each level, changing "your" to "his", since the Aramaic says almost the same (m1).

decisions.choice: os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} sinais ... o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} reino
decisions.reason: Where the English "His" opens a sentence and so has no span, the Portuguese possessive follows an article ("Os seus sinais", "O seu reino") and is never sentence-initial, so it takes the deity_pronoun span at every level.

decisions.choice: "Su reino [es] reino de todos los siglos" (L); "Su reino es un reino para todos los siglos" (B)
decisions.reason: Worded as Psalm 145:13 in Spanish, which these lines echo

decisions.choice: the second half worded as Psalm 145:13
decisions.reason: The king's words echo Psalm 145:13, so the Vietnamese reuses the published wording of that verse at each level.

decisions.choice: spans on every possessive, "Ishara {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}", "Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}"
alternatives: no span where the English line begins "His"
decisions.reason: The Swahili possessive follows its noun, so it never stands at the start of a line and always takes a span.

decisions.choice: The last two lines follow the Hindi of Psalm 145:13, in the third person
decisions.reason: The king's words echo Psalm 145:13. Hindi keeps that psalm's wording at each level ("सब युगों का राज्य", "पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक"), changing only तेरा to the honorific उनका, since the king speaks of God rather than to him.

decisions.choice: the wording of Psalm 145:13 in the second half (L, B)
decisions.reason: The last two lines repeat Psalm 145:13 (m1), so they keep that psalm's Russian wording at Literal and Balanced, changing "your" to "his".

decisions.choice: kemah "なんと…ことか！" with ！ at every level
decisions.reason: The Aramaic exclaims here ("how great!"); the same lines recur in 4:31 and 6:27.
